original_sentence: However, more often than not, in our eagerness to seek individual success, we lose friends along the way and that has become part of the process.
translation: 然而，很多时候，在急于追求个人成功的过程中，我们一路上失去了朋友，而这已经成了这个过程的一部分。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: more often than not 在本句中对应"往往；多半"。
along the way 在本句中对应"一路上；过程中"。
eagerness to 在本句中对应"急于……"。
part of 在本句中对应"……的一部分"。
individual success 在本句中对应"个人成功"。
